inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The comparison names and cites the closest relevant work, distinguishes the joint higher-content, zero-content, formal-object, and compact-uniform dependency design, and keeps any novelty or priority statement within the cited evidence.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A focused comparison names and cites the closest local-obstruction, fail-fast, formal-product, and certificate-method work; distinguishes the manuscript's joint higher-content, zero-content, formal-object, and compact-uniform dependency design from those traditions; and confines every novelty or priority statement to what the cited evidence supports.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript adds a genuine closest-work comparison or bounds its contribution, but omits one or more relevant traditions, does not clearly distinguish the combined dependency design, or retains a novelty or priority statement that exceeds the cited evidence.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: The manuscript adds or strengthens originality, field-general significance, novelty, or priority claims without closer cited evidence, or further obscures how the combined dependency design differs from established traditions.

operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: The manuscript strengthens artifact-level reproducibility or replay claims without a resolving locator and complete manifest, introduces conflicting artifact bindings, or presents an uncreated future scientific dossier as currently available.
